scenes.purpose: Land the figure first: the share of oil, propane and electric homes with AC that the model says save.

visual.description: One stat tile centred in the portrait frame; the figure 95%–100% lands on "95" and holds while the sentence names the homes it covers and attributes it to the study.

chart.title: Oil, propane or electric
chart.note: Homes that already have air conditioning; a modelled estimate, not measured bills.

scenes.direction: Cold open; the tile lands on "95" and holds to the end of the sentence.
scenes.narration: 95 to 100 percent of homes heating with oil, propane or electricity, and already running air conditioning, would pay less with a heat pump, a national study estimates.

scenes.purpose: Say plainly that the figure is modelled, not metered.

visual.description: Dark field; three short lines build down the frame as the sentence moves: it is a model, the bills were simulated, nobody's meter was read.

scenes.direction: Lines on "model", "simulated" and "meter"; hold on the last.
scenes.narration: Estimates, because it is a model: the study simulated those homes' bills, so the figure is not a reading from anyone's meter.

scenes.purpose: Pair the share with the median saving, both for the same homes, both moving with efficiency.

visual.description: Two stat tiles stacked in the portrait frame, reused from the main video: the share of homes paying less above, the median yearly saving below; the dollar tile lands on "$300".

chart.title: Oil, propane or electric
chart.note: Modelled estimate across heat pump efficiency levels, not measured bills; homes with air conditioning only.

scenes.direction: Top tile already in place from the hook; the saving tile lands on "$300"; hold a beat.
scenes.narration: Its median saving, $300 to $650 a year, is for those same homes and moves with the heat pump's efficiency.

scenes.purpose: Show the AC condition doing the work: the same fuels without it fall to 73 to 86 percent.

visual.description: Two horizontal bars, with AC above, without AC below; the lower bar draws on "only" and stops visibly short of the upper one.

chart.title: Share paying less
chart.note: Each bar is drawn at the low end of its modelled range; same fuels, same model.

scenes.direction: Upper bar in place at the cut; lower bar draws on "only"; hold after the sentence.
scenes.narration: Drop the air conditioning and the same model is weaker: only 73 to 86 percent come out ahead.

scenes.purpose: Close: point to the full inquiry; the video draws this as the end card.

visual.description: End card drawn by the video (seal, the full inquiry's question, the call to action); no lines of its own.

scenes.direction: Hold the end card to the last word and a beat after.
scenes.narration: Whether metered homes agree with the model is the subject of the full inquiry.
